work.description: Fragment witness; the source omits part of the act. The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Fragment of CXXXIII: explicit Sixtus protocol4524–4525 and preamble4527–4544 precede current own §1, introduced in the first person at4546–4549 and terminated by etc. plus note1. Historical note4585–4586 explicitly omits its remainder and refers to an earlier printing of the constitution. No quoted predecessor protocol or tenor introduction intervenes; the missing material is the remainder of the current act’s §1 after4549 and before §2 at4551, with its amount unknown. Surviving §§2–19, historical notes4530–4531 and4585–4586, margins, Nulli ergo5186 and own dating5188–5194 remain cleanly bounded before CXXXIV5197. Preserve this surviving fragment; do not describe it as the complete act or expand the omission.
